items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Well, Kid René played, uh, trumpet.

ctx.x: I want a big Butter and Eggman.

Yeah. Come be my, no, I'll be, uh, Butter and Eggman. Well, two, three people used to think, he was saying that so good, Talbot, you know, which was Cuckoo. He, uh, a lot of people would come to us and say, that's the Butter and Eggman? So we'd say, yeah, that's the Butter and Eggman. And he used to go around advertising trucks, you know, in our trucks, uh, them furniture waves. When he was gonna have a dance like at the Lions Club or Santa Centers. Well, most times they'd have two bands. They'd have René, you…
He told me he was, yes. Yeah.
